label: Characterizing a cell
subgoals: Extract candidate opens and shorts from the cell layout
Simulate each defect at transistor level over all input patterns
Record the detecting patterns as a per-cell fault table

label: Finding the detecting pattern
subgoals: Write the fault-free output column of the cell
Compare it row by row with the defective column
Pick an input pattern on a differing row

label: Sequential and delay behaviour
subgoals: Recognize a stuck-open as a defect that makes the cell sequential
Apply an initializing pattern before the exposing pattern
Classify defects whose exposing pattern cannot occur as untestable
